sentences.8.2 Bjørnar liker å gå på loppemarked: 8.2 Bjørnar likes going to flea markets
sentences.Det er søndag, og Bjørnar er på loppemar: It's Sunday, and Bjørnar is at a flea market at a school in town.
sentences.Han liker å kjøpe gamle, fine ting på lo: He likes buying nice old things at flea markets, and now he needs some chairs for the kitchen.
sentences.På loppemarkedet selger de mange gamle m: At the flea market they sell lots of old furniture.
sentences.De har også mange forskjellige ting, som: They also have lots of different things, such as clothes, books, glasses and dinnerware.
There are lots of people there.
sentences.Noen går bare og kikker, men noen handle: Some just walk around and look, but some buy a lot.
sentences.Hei, Bjørnar! Er du også her i dag?: Hi, Bjørnar! Are you here today too?
sentences.Hei, Ingrid! Så hyggelig å se deg. Leter: Hi, Ingrid! How nice to see you. Are you looking for anything in particular?
sentences.Ja, jeg har så lyst til å kjøpe et nytt: Yes, I'd really like to buy a new table for the flat.
There are lots of nice things here.
sentences.Ja, det er mange fine møbler her. Jeg le: Yes, there's lots of nice furniture here. I'm looking for chairs for the kitchen table.
sentences.Jeg så noen fine kjøkkenstoler der borte: I saw some nice kitchen chairs over there.
sentences.Det er mange stoler på loppemarkedet, og: There are lots of chairs at the flea market, and Bjørnar finds four cheap chairs.
sentences.Ingrid kjøper mange brukte bøker og et g: Ingrid buys lots of second-hand books and a nice old table.
sentences.Bjørnar har tilhenger på bilen og kjører: Bjørnar has a trailer on his car and drives the table home to Ingrid's.
sentences.Han hjelper henne med å bære det inn, fo: He helps her carry it in, because it's a bit heavy.
sentences.Tusen takk for hjelpen, Bjørnar!: Thank you so much for your help, Bjørnar!
sentences.Bare hyggelig, men kan du kanskje hjelpe: You're welcome, but could you maybe help me with something?
sentences.Ja, gjerne. Hva tenker du på?: Yes, I'd be happy to. What are you thinking of?
sentences.Jeg trenger å klippe håret. Har du en le: I need a haircut. Do you have a free appointment one day?
sentences.Ja, selvfølgelig! Jeg kan klippe deg, og: Yes, of course! I can cut your hair, and you can help me find a new car!
